subject: Request to unlock lapsed pilot access for Avery Labs — credit extension
messages:
From: Sam Tully <sam.tully@averylabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot expired — can we get a short credit unlock for our follow-up demo?

Hi Rishi,

Quick one — our pilot for the internal dev team just expired (we hit the token cap last week). We have a customer-facing demo scheduled the week of Nov 23rd and the team needs a few more days of access to reproduce a repro and finalize the integration.

Could Redwood unlock the lapsed credits or extend our trial window for ~10 business days so we can complete the demo? I attached the usage snapshot for the pilot.

Attachments: pilot-usage-report.csv (CSV, 18KB)

If there's any approval process or paperwork needed, let me know and I can pull in procurement. Appreciate your help.

—Sam
Sam Tully
Head of Platform Integrations
Avery Labs
sam.tully@averylabs.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Tully <sam.tully@averylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot expired — can we get a short credit unlock for our follow-up demo?

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the context and for sending the usage report. We can usually make a one-time exception to unlock pilot access for a short evaluation window. I need to get a quick internal approval (finance + commercial) and confirm any limits. Can you confirm:

- Exact dates you need access (start/end)
- Whether the demo environment will be accessible to external customers or kept internal
- Any PO or procurement contact we should loop in if we need formal paperwork

I'll loop in Marissa (my manager) and Dev (finance ops) to expedite. If approved, I expect we can do a 10–14 day extension and a small conditional credit grant.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot expired — can we get a short credit unlock for our follow-up demo?

Looping in my quick take so we have a record:

- Finance is okay with a one-off $5,000 credit top-up (internal cost estimate ~ $1,900) for a maximum of 14 days, contingent on a signed credit addendum (simple DocuSign) and that the environment is not used for production workloads.
- We should also attach a short note to the deal in HubSpot and mark it as a one-time concession.

I'll prepare the small approval slate (credit-approval-slate.pdf) and send the DocuSign link to the external contact once Marissa signs off.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Finance Operations Manager
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Tully <sam.tully@averylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot expired — credit extension approved (DocuSign link)

Hi Sam — good news.

We approved a one-time credit unlock: $5,000 in pilot credits for a 14-day evaluation window starting when you accept the addendum. Conditions:

- Use limited to evaluation/demo environments (no production inference).
- Addendum must be signed via DocuSign (link below).
- Any overages will be billed to the account per standard pricing after the window.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/83412

Attachment: credit-approval-slate.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

If that works, click the DocuSign link to accept and I’ll unlock access within one business hour of completion.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Sam Tully <sam.tully@averylabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot expired — credit extension approved (DocuSign link)

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround and thanks Dev/Marissa for being flexible.

I'm signing the addendum now. A couple of quick follow-ups:

- Can you confirm how we'll track remaining credit during the 14 days? Is there a dashboard or should we request token-level export?
- If we need to convert to paid capacity after the demo, who should we contact for provisioning?

Also looping procurement (procurement@averylabs.com) in case they want an invoice or PO after the demo.

Attachment: N/A

—Sam
Sam Tully
Head of Platform Integrations
Avery Labs
sam.tully@averylabs.com
